prompt_set:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CH01 EAST-facing four-pose animation source atlas B, requested native 2048 x 2048, genuine transparent background. Reference1 fixes EXACT character detail, anatomy scale and true EAST-facing camera from source A; Reference2 fixes identity and weapon. NEW FOUR DIFFERENT POSES, not copies of reference poses.
Exact 2x2 layout, four fully separate complete bodies each in one quadrant. High camera three-quarter near-isometric hand-painted 2.5D bright fantasy, warm upper-left sunlight. Adult male short brown hair; navy fitted split coat, silver sculpted armor and small gold fittings, vermilion scarf; same giant gold-silver crescent volcanic-rune axe with orange sunstone. All four look and step toward SCREEN RIGHT, EAST angle0 degrees, head and boots and weapon target aligned rightward, not southeast.
Frame0 top-left committed basic strike contact: hands extended screen-right, axe blade sweeping rightward low in front, weight on forward foot. Frame1 top-right basic recovery: hands drawing the axe back beside waist, weight returning toward center. Frame2 bottom-left dash: torso leaned forward but face/head kept at normal fullbody height, long powerful rightward lunge, bent back leg, axe tucked compactly behind hip, no trail. Frame3 bottom-right guard/cast: upright braced stance, both hands holding shaft crosswise before chest, full blade beside torso, chin rightward, preparing battlecry.
Each character head-top to average shoe-sole contact 450–550 actual pixels if canvas1254. Keep TOTAL body and whole axe no wider than530 pixels. Short scarf. EVERY figure has at least35px genuine transparent margin inside its quadrant at x=0/627/1254 and y=0/627/1254. Compact axe bends elbow and does not extend beyond own cell; all complete weapons and both shoes visible. No cropped parts, intercell overlaps, detached chips, trails, magic FX, ground, shadow, labels, text or watermark. Exact same face and costume and paint finish across A/B.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY spacing and compact pose geometry in this four-pose EAST-facing warrior source sheet B. Preserve character identity, outfit, face, painted quality, four distinct actions and complete whole weapons. Genuine transparent 2x2 atlas.
IMPORTANT: the TOP LEFT axe currently crosses into top right cell. Re-compose that whole top-left figure to fit x35..592,y35..592 in the actual1254 canvas. Bring his forward hand and elbow close to his chest, and tilt the whole axe upright right in front of his knee rather than projecting it far horizontally. Slightly more compact axe and stance is necessary. TOP RIGHT entirely x662..1219,y35..592. BOTTOM LEFT entirely x35..592,y662..1219. BOTTOM RIGHT entirely x662..1219,y662..1219. No opaque pixel outside these four safe rectangles, no thin scarf at the edges. This is four separate complete figures, NOT clipping/cropping them. Shorten scarf and narrow the wide lunges while preserving head-to-sole body scale about480 actualpixels.
Actions remain: top-left committed heavy EASTWARD attack release/forward impact, top-right recovering axe to waist, bottom-left low rightward dash with axe behind torso, bottom-right upright braced guard/battlecry with crosswise shaft. All TRUE EAST SCREEN-RIGHT facing. Same anatomy and face as reference, no shadow, floor, particles, streaks, labels, text or extra characters. Compact geometry must still visibly articulate all four actions.
